rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a very poor-quality early blastocyst and absent/degenerative ICM/TE, but it overstates certainty from a single image, assigns 1–2 expansion despite provided 0DD, and mentions features like extruded cells/zona thinning not clearly verifiable.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, endometrium, sperm, diagnosis, and first-cycle status with the poor embryo quality and overall prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis appropriately driven by embryo quality; minor issues include speculative links to alcohol/stress and protocol choice.

Mostly aligned in recognizing very poor prognosis and counseling, but some recommendations are weakly guideline-based or controversial for this case (routine PGT-A in a 28-year-old, ERA mention, DHEA/oxidative stress testing, protocol changes based on one cycle).
Provides clear counseling and future-cycle suggestions with practical next steps, though some proposed investigations/interventions are more speculative than standard.
